moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament culminates in its Men's and Women's Finals Day at Lord's Cricket Ground on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Anticipation for the Final
angles.copy: Who's making it to Lord's? The Hundred Finals Day is just over a week away, with teams battling it out for the men's and women's titles. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Countdown to Lord's
angles.copy: The biggest day in 100-ball cricket is almost here! Finals Day for The Hundred takes over Lord's on Sunday, August 16th. Don't miss the action.

moments.title: The Hundred Group Stage Continues
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 season is in full swing with daily matches across the UK, leading up to the Finals Day on August 16th.

angles.name: Daily Matches Update
angles.copy: Another day, another double-header in The Hundred! Catch the men's and women's teams battling it out today. Who's your local favourite?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Update
angles.copy: How are our Welsh Fire doing in The Hundred? Keep up with all the action as the tournament progresses towards Finals Day!

moments.title: Green Man Festival Approaching
moments.blurb: The Green Man Festival, Wales' largest music, arts, and science festival, takes place in the Brecon Beacons from August 20-23, 2026, featuring artists like Mogwai, Wilco, Four Tet, and Wolf Alice.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is just around the corner! Getting ready for four days of incredible music, arts, and comedy in the beautiful Brecon Beacons? #GreenMan2026

angles.name: Line-up excitement
angles.copy: The countdown to Green Man is on! Mogwai, Wilco, Four Tet, Wolf Alice and more are heading to the Brecon Beacons from August 20-23. Who are you most excited to see?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Preview
moments.blurb: The late August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Planning Ahead
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday is just over three weeks away! Are you planning a staycation, a day trip, or just looking forward to a long weekend?

angles.name: End of Summer Vibes
angles.copy: Even though it's still a bit away, the August Bank Holiday on the 31st marks the unofficial end of summer. How are you making the most of the last weeks?
